summary: At a German supermarket, newcomer Marta finds that the shopping cart is chained. Lukas shows her the coin slot. She unlocks the cart with her last euro, then sees her empty purse. The coin is refundable when the cart is returned; her immediate dilemma is the joke.
cliffhanger: Next time Marta returns the cart and gets her euro back.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.scene: Premium expressive 3D cartoon, ordinary German supermarket entrance in daylight. Only adult newcomer Marta visible, mustard top and teal dungarees. Medium three-quarter framing shows her face, hand, front shopping cart and a short, visibly attached metal cart chain. She pulls once and the chain stops the cart. The coin lock and its one-euro icon are visible on the handle. Grounded physical comedy, clear silhouettes, no fantasy props, no other face.
scenes.motion: Marta gives the cart one natural tug; it moves a few centimeters and stops against the taut chain. She looks down at the lock and speaks with natural German lip sync. Only Marta's mouth moves.
scenes.object_action: Marta pulls the chained cart and it stops visibly.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Ein Euro oder ein Chip löst die Kette.
scenes.fa: یک یورو یا چیپ، زنجیر را باز می‌کند.
scenes.scene: Same supermarket entrance, same cart, chain and coin lock. Only adult Lukas visible, copper hair, turquoise glasses and coral hoodie. Tight medium three-quarter view keeps his face, index finger, lock and one-euro symbol simultaneously readable. He points to the lock while Marta stays off camera. Polished 3D cartoon lighting, physically plausible mechanism, no other face.
scenes.motion: Lukas points once to the coin slot while speaking, then drops his hand. Natural German lip sync on Lukas alone. The cart stays chained and motionless during this explanation.
scenes.object_action: Lukas points at the cart's coin slot.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Super. Ein Wagen, aber kein Geld fürs Brot!
scenes.fa: عالی! حالا چرخ دارم، اما برای نان پول ندارم!
scenes.scene: Same entrance, only Marta visible. Medium three-quarter shot shows her face and hand, unlocked shopping cart, short released chain, one-euro coin seated in the lock, and her open visibly empty purse. Her surprised glance from cart to purse carries the joke. No other person or face. Premium expressive 3D cartoon, readable action, subtitle-safe lower margin.
scenes.motion: Marta inserts her one-euro coin, the chain releases, and she rolls the cart a short distance. She opens her purse, sees it is empty, glances at the cart, and delivers the dry punchline with natural lip sync. No second speaker, no slow motion.
scenes.object_action: Marta unlocks the cart, opens her empty purse, and reacts to losing access to her only coin until she returns the cart.
